about: Gold-label corrections for the gretel-finance test sample, applied by `python -m pii_guard.eval.datasets fetch gretel-finance-corrected` to build the separate set gretel-finance-corrected. The upstream fixture files and their manifest are not changed, and every system keeps its upstream score on gretel-finance. A rule matches a gold span of one of its entity types whose text, with runs of whitespace collapsed to one space, equals one of its values exactly (case-sensitive). The rules match on the span's own text only, never on what any system predicted. A matched span stops being gold and becomes an ignore region labelled `corrected:<rule id>`: leaving it unmasked is not a leak, masking it is not over-masking, and every system is treated alike. The values were chosen by reading every distinct gold value of the sample (PERSON: 275 de, 159 en; the other types in full), not any system's output. Kept as gold on purpose: placeholder names used as a person's name (Max Mustermann, John Doe), spans that hold a name next to a greeting (Hallo Lola), user-name-like names (Carina20), address parts labelled PERSON (Mettmann, An der Wupper: they are still about a place someone lives or works). A value is listed only when it is not a name wherever it occurs in the sample; the ones that could be (Peers, Hoch, Sedan, Engineering, BALI15) were read in context.

rules.rationale: A template field or its label, not a value: square-bracket slots left in the generated text and words that name a field. There is no person, address, number or mailbox in them.
Salutations, thanks, set phrases, pronouns and function words labelled as names ("Sehr geehrte Damen und Herren" yields the spans Damen and Herren). They identify nobody.
German "Ihr/Ihre/Ihren/Ihres + noun" ("your trust", "your basket") labelled as names. A possessive and a common noun; no name in them.

Dictionary words labelled as names: finance terms (Saldo, Betrag), products and materials (Stahl, Seife, Sedan), safety-sheet and medical terms, a department (Engineering), a gender word (maennlich), and two truncated words (Absaug, Meld). Read in context; none is used as a name.
A role or a party in a contract, not a person's name ("the debtor", "employee 1", "valued customer"). A role word identifies nobody on its own.
A number, a voucher code or an EDI segment labelled as a name or an e-mail address. None names a person or a mailbox.
